title: Priyanka Chopra FaceTimed Nick Jonas from Wimbledon's Royal Box. The Internet Lost It.
excerpt: Fresh off Paris Couture Week in Dior florals, Bollywood's most global star showed up at the All England Club in all white — and made a phone call that broke the internet.
body:
Key Takeaways
  • Priyanka Chopra FaceTimed Nick Jonas from Wimbledon's Royal Box, captivating fans worldwide.
  • Her Wimbledon appearance followed a stunning showcase at Paris Couture Week.
  • Priyanka's return to Indian cinema is highly anticipated with her film *Varanasi* set for 2027.
  • She remains the only Indian actress headlining major projects in both Hollywood and Bollywood.
  • The moment symbolizes her journey from India to global stardom, resonating with the diaspora.
Here's what it looks like when you're the most famous Indian woman on the planet and you have ten minutes to kill before a Wimbledon match: you FaceTime your husband from the Royal Box and let the photographers catch the whole thing. **Priyanka Chopra Jonas** was spotted at Day 11 of the Wimbledon Championships on Wednesday, seated among the tournament's most distinguished guests at the All England Lawn Tennis and Croquet Club. She looked exactly as good as you'd expect — elegant white ensemble, perfectly aligned with Wimbledon's century-old dress code, her signature voluminous curls framing her face. But the outfit wasn't what broke social media. The moment came before the match, when cameras caught Priyanka grinning at her phone screen, holding it up for a FaceTime call with **Nick Jonas**, who wasn't at the venue. The pictures went everywhere within the hour. Fans called it adorable. Fashion watchers dissected the look. The internet, collectively, decided that long-distance love from a Royal Box was the most Priyanka thing imaginable. "Adorable" doesn't quite capture it, though. There's something specifically resonant about this image for the diaspora — a woman from Jamshedpur who conquered Miss World, then Bollywood, then Hollywood, casually video-calling her Grammy-winning husband from the same box where royals sit. It's a flex so quiet it barely registers as one. The Wimbledon appearance caps off a week that has been pure Priyanka. Days earlier, she was at **Paris Couture Week** sitting front row at Dior, wearing a showstopping orange floral dress from Jonathan Anderson's debut collection. Nick was beside her at the Dior show in a grey suit with Dior sneakers — the couple nailing coordinated style without ever matching. Priyanka's look quickly became a street-style highlight of the entire couture calendar. At this point, her 2026 fashion run reads like a greatest-hits tour. The **custom white Dior gown at the Oscars** in April. The Bvlgari necklace that added quiet old-money weight. The floral Dior at Paris. Now the whites at Wimbledon. Every appearance calibrated, every reference intentional, and every outfit demonstrating what diaspora audiences have known for years: Priyanka doesn't just belong in these rooms. She dominates them. > She FaceTimed Nick Jonas from Wimbledon's Royal Box. That's the kind of energy money can't buy. What makes this moment land harder than a typical celebrity sighting is the context of what comes next. Priyanka is deep in preparation for her most anticipated project in years: **S.S. Rajamouli's *Varanasi***, the epic adventure film alongside **Mahesh Babu** and **Prithviraj Sukumaran**. It will be her first Indian film since *The Sky Is Pink* in 2019 — an eight-year gap that has only amplified the anticipation. The film, rumoured to be the first Indian production (and the first non-English film) shot in full 1.43:1 IMAX format, is expected to release on April 7, 2027.

For NRI audiences who've watched Priyanka navigate Hollywood — from *Quantico* to *Citadel* to *The Bluff* — the return to Indian cinema via Rajamouli feels like a homecoming that's been years in the making. And she's not coming back quietly. She's coming back in what might be the most technically ambitious Indian film ever made, directed by the man who made *RRR* a global phenomenon. There's also **Judgment Day**, her upcoming Hollywood film, keeping her dual-continent career humming without pause. She remains the only Indian actress actively headlining on both sides of the Pacific, a status that no one else has seriously threatened. Back at Wimbledon, Priyanka was seen cheering during the match, taking in the atmosphere with the ease of someone who has been at these events a hundred times and still genuinely enjoys them. Fellow celebrities at this year's tournament included **Cynthia Erivo**, **Lily James**, **Elle Fanning**, and **Queen Camilla** — a guest list that says everything about the company Priyanka keeps.

For the millions of desi fans watching from their phones in New Jersey, Toronto, and London, the image of Priyanka laughing into a FaceTime with Nick from the Royal Box isn't just a cute couple moment. It's a reminder of how far this particular story has travelled — from Bareilly and Jamshedpur to the most exclusive seats in global entertainment. The white dress. The royal setting. The casual video call to the love of her life. She makes it look effortless. It never was.
